items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: you have Joan Baez, Pete Seeger, Peter, Paul & Mary, Benny Goodman and an unknown folk singer.

ctx.x: Oh really. But your father liked the fact that you had all these associations with these musicians.

Yeah my mother did too. I mean we went to the events. But the person who I’m leaving out from a family thing is that so my father and mother took me to these things, and I went out and then the musicians took me to some of these things. But my cousin Bill, Bill Schaap, Dick’s younger brother, he stepped into the breech and started, I piggy backed on his enthusiasms and goodness. I mean he’s a good guy. His wife stopped answering the telephone because I took him out of the house and I guess she didn’t like jazz.…
